question: Which source regions and pattern/value/interaction operations generate the complete H3-Q8 response on v10 after the older subject-only rule failed to transfer?

authority.status: Subject base-pattern values leave 36.15%/45.99% of Q8 norm unexplained and miss composed behavior, despite exact c_v reconstruction.

frozen_partition.definition: Per row, the groups form an exact disjoint partition of every causal source position through the answer query. Cue is the unique changed token; subject_onset is the two declared writer destinations; self is the query; pre/post groups are the remaining intervals.
frozen_partition.coordinate_measure: Project every exact group-factor H3 head-output term into frozen Q8 and require their complete sum to equal the live H3-Q8 response.
frozen_partition.behavior_measure: For every one of 18 cells, six group unions, three factor unions, the causal-suffix union, and the complete sum, map its Q8 vector through the released output-weight residual route and score exact finite answer/foil effects.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_partition_factor_: Hashes, source partition, head/Q8 factor closure, capture reconstruction, complete endpoint replay, finite coverage, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_all_source_value_is_the_dominant_: The all-source base-pattern value union has the largest mean-absolute causal effect of the three factor unions and retains at least 80% of complete behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_causal_suffix_sources_close_the_r: The union of subject_onset, post_subject, and self across all factors retains at least 90% of complete Q8 norm and causal behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_pre_subject_value_change_is_zero: Prefix, cue, and pre_subject base-pattern value terms are numerically zero because the L8 intervention is written only at later subject destinations.
predictions.pred_e_subject_is_material_but_not_compl: Subject_onset alone retains between 40% and 80% of complete Q8 norm in both panels, matching the observed construction shift without relabeling it as diffuse noise.

decision: A passing common causal-suffix/value account becomes the upstream writer tensor. If causal suffix fails but one common ranked union closes, freeze that union for a new-bank confirmation. If source rankings differ across A1/A2, define construction-conditioned reachable coordinates and move to the finite Hankel shared-state test rather than forcing one semantic source label.
